description: LATERAL FLATTEN comma shorthand works; the JOIN ... ON form is rejected. Converted 1:1 from features/LateralFlattenTest.java (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER, tags VARIANT)
SELECT e.id, f.value FROM events e, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => e.tags) f ORDER BY e.id, f.value
CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER, tags VARIANT)
SELECT e.id, f.value FROM events e JOIN LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => e.tags) f ON TRUE
SELECT e.id, f.value FROM events e, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => e.tags) f ORDER BY e.id, f.value
